description: Outlook-style reading pane for the Thunderbird Conversations view: newest message on top (optionally alone), and replies and forwards written inline in the pane; new messages in a dock at the bottom of the main window.

functions.name: configure
functions.description: Sets { enabled, newestFirst, expandAll, foldQuotes, attachmentsTop, latestOnly, inlineReply, inlineNew, pinButton, pinKeyword, undoSendSeconds, replyHeader, removeQuoteBar } and applies it to open conversation views. Returns the same object as status().

functions.name: conversationsState
functions.description: Whether Thunderbird Conversations is installed and enabled: { installed, enabled, version, appVersion }. Read only: the add-on never installs or enables it.

functions.name: sanitizeHtml
functions.description: The given HTML fragment cleaned by Thunderbird's sanitizer (no scripts, event handlers, javascript: URLs, frames, objects or forms).

functions.name: setSignature
functions.description: Makes the given HTML (pictures as data: URLs) the HTML signature of the identity, cleaned like an imported file. Returns { email, images, missing, size }.

functions.name: getSignature
functions.description: The identity's signature as the reading pane uses it (sanitized HTML, pictures as data: URLs); empty if it has none.

functions.name: importSignature
functions.description: Asks for an Outlook signature file (.htm) and makes it the HTML signature of the identity, with its images inside. Returns { email, images, missing, size } or { cancelled: true }.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Returns { conversations, conversationsVersion, panes, routedWindows, drafts, pendingSends, newMessages, dock, composeRoutedWindows, lastError }.

events.name: onPopOut
events.description: The user moved an inline reply or new message to a compose window: { messageId (null for a new message), type (new, reply, replyAll, forward), identityId, to, cc, bcc (arrays), subject, html }.

events.name: onOpenSettings
events.description: The composer asked for Outlook Mode's settings, at a section (an id in the settings page, or empty).

events.name: onPin
events.description: The pin button (Conversations' star) of a message was clicked.

events.name: onSendResult
events.description: An inline reply was sent or failed: { ok, error, subject, shown } (shown: an open reading pane displayed the result).
